name: lectern
description: A lectern with a sloping reading surface and a complete supporting pedestal.
useCase: Identify a lectern, speaking position or reading stand.
misuse: Use presentation for a slide screen rather than the speaker’s furniture.

16.reason: The full sloping reading surface remains distinct above a broad supporting pedestal.

24.reason: A complete sloped top and centered pedestal keep the lectern balanced in its square frame.
